name: ESO 308-G022 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 308-G022, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso308g022-hubble
story: ESO 308-G022 is a rather isolated dwarf irregular galaxy with a slowly turning disk of hydrogen gas; Hubble photographed it to measure its distance from its brightest red giant stars and help map the nearby universe in three dimensions.

claims.text: ESO 308-G022 is a rather isolated dwarf irregular galaxy
ESO 308-G022 is also known as HIPASS J0639-40
ESO 308-G022 has a regularly rotating disk of hydrogen gas
Hubble program 13442 observed ESO 308-G022 to measure distances to nearby galaxies with the tip of the red giant branch
Program 13442 uses the distances to build three-dimensional maps of nearby galaxies
